$comment: Generated from ConfigSchema.pkl. Do not edit by hand.
title: Lanterna config
description: Settings vessel for Lanterna. Strict: unknown keys invalidate the whole file.

version.description: Schema generation. Stays 1 for this revision.

appearanceMode.description: The appearance the panel and the guide windows use. Absent means "system".

romajiScope.description: The scope the romaji filter matches in. Absent means "kanji".

forcedInputSource.description:
The input source ID (such as "com.apple.keylayout.ABC") selected while
the panel is up; the user's own comes back when it goes. Absent means
off. An empty string invalidates the whole file.

shortcutMemoryLength.description:
How many characters of a query the shortcut memory covers: a longer
query is neither recorded nor applied. 0 means off. Absent means 5.
Values above 5 invalidate the whole file (mirrored by the Swift
validation, which also enforces the upper bound).

fuzzyMatchEnabled.description:
Whether the filter also matches subsequence queries, not only
substrings. Absent means on.

listWindowsOnAllSpaces.description:
Whether the list also reads windows on desktops no display is
showing, which takes longer. Absent means off.

resultOrder.description: The order the narrowed rows draw in. Absent means "mru".

otherSpaceMode.description: Windows on other Spaces. Absent means "show".

hiddenAppMode.description: Windows of hidden applications. Absent means "separateAtBottom".

windowlessAppMode.description:
Running applications with no open window, each listed as a row of its
own. Absent means "hide".

sampleCount.description:
Fixture entries to show instead of live windows.
Absent means live windows. Must be zero or more when present.

stopMonitorEvery.description:
Intentional monitor stops, in whole seconds, so recovery can be watched.
Absent means an ordinary run. Must be one or more when present.

launchAtLogin.description: Whether Lanterna starts at login. Absent means off.

logLevel.description:
Deprecated; ignored. Every level is recorded now, and the log window
filters what it shows. Any value is accepted so older files keep
their other settings.

saveLogsToDisk.description:
Whether each launch's log lines are kept on disk, so an earlier
launch can be read after a restart. Absent means on.

updateCheckEnabled.description: Whether Lanterna checks for newer releases. Absent means off.

hoverSelect.description: Whether hovering a row moves the selection. Absent means off.

scrollSelect.description: Whether scrolling moves the selection. Absent means off.

reopenWindowlessApps.description:
Whether taking an application row with no open window opens one, doing
what that application's Dock icon does. Absent means off.

raiseOnlyChosenWindow.description:
Whether taking a window row brings only that window forward, trying to
leave the application's other windows where they were on every display.
A workaround for the platform bringing another window of the same
application forward along with the chosen one. Absent means off.

autoFocusSingleCandidate.description:
Whether a filter that narrows to one row focuses that row and closes
the panel. Absent means on.

numberJump.description:
Whether holding Command or Option and pressing a row number jumps to
that row. Absent means off.

numberReorder.description:
Whether moving the selected row by key works in grouped lists.
Absent means off.

numberScope.description: The rows row numbers cover. Absent means "windows".

hintsMode.description: How the left edge of each row reads. Absent means "prefix".

rowOrder.description:
Hand-arranged row orders by manual group. Entries that are invalid on
their own are ignored one by one. Absent means no overrides.

updateChannel.description: The releases the check covers. Absent means "stable".

exclusions.description:
Windows to keep out of the switcher list. Absent means no exclusions.
Elements that are invalid on their own are ignored one by one.

keybindings.description: User-configurable keybindings. Absent means all defaults.

textScale.description:
The panel text and icon scale as a multiplier: one of the five steps.
Absent means 1.0 (the current size). The value allowlist lives in
Swift, like the upper bound of `shortcutMemoryLength`.

panelWidth.description:
The panel width as a multiplier over the text-scaled width: one of
the allowed steps. Absent means 1.0 (the text-scaled width
unchanged). The value allowlist lives in Swift, like `textScale`.

panelRows.description:
How many rows the panel shows before the list scrolls, 5 to 30.
Absent means 10. Anything else falls back to 10 with a note. The
range lives in Swift, like `panelWidth`'s steps.

showDelayMs.description:
The panel show delay in milliseconds before the panel appears.
Absent or zero means off. Past 1000 clamps to it with a note, and
anything else unreadable falls back to 150 with a note. The bounds
live in Swift, like `panelWidth`.

windowScope.description:
Every application's windows, or only those of the application in
front when the panel opens. Absent means "allApps".

displayTarget.description:
The menu-bar display, the cursor's display, the focused window's
display, or every display. Absent means "primary".

grouping.description:
One list, one group per Space with the shown Spaces first, or groups
made by assigning applications. Absent means "none".

otherSpacePlacement.description:
Where the windows-on-other-spaces section goes when grouped. Absent means "endOfList".
Ignored when grouping by Space, which puts those windows in their own Space's group.

hiddenAppPlacement.description: Where the hidden-apps section goes when grouped. Absent means "endOfList".

minimizedPlacement.description: Where the minimized section goes when grouped. Absent means "endOfList".

fullscreenPlacement.description: Where the fullscreen section goes when grouped. Absent means "endOfList".

windowlessAppPlacement.description:
Where the apps-without-windows section goes when grouped. Absent means "endOfList".
Grouping by Space always puts it after the last group, since those apps are on no Space.

groupCount.description: How many manual groups there are, 1 to 9. Absent means 1.

groupHeadingStyle.description:
The group number, the name given to the group, or the names of the
apps in it. Absent means "number".

groupNames.description:
The names given to manual groups, keyed "1" to "9". Names for groups
past the count are kept. Absent means no names.

groupAssignments.description:
Applications assigned to manual groups. Entries that are invalid on
their own, or name an application an earlier entry named, are ignored
one by one. Absent means every application joins the first group.

switchers.description:
The two switchers side by side. Absent means the long-standing
behaviour: the main switcher follows the top-level keys, and the
parallel switcher shows the front application's windows alone.
